content: JVM container memory: kernel OOM-killer kills at RSS > cgroup limit with exit 137/OOMKilled true and NO Java exception. Heap is only part of RSS: metaspace (80-150MB Spring Boot), code cache (40-80MB), thread stacks, Netty direct buffers (WebFlux/SCG!) all count. Historical default MaxRAMPercentage=25% of container limit; JDK CSR JDK-8356194 raises default to 75% when container memory limit present (recent JDK line). Explicitly pin -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75 (65 if AOP/proxy-heavy); do NOT set both -Xmx and MaxRAMPercentage (-Xmx wins silently). Add -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError for loud failure. JDK 21.0.9-and-earlier misreads limits on Linux kernel 6.12+. Verify with docker exec <c> jcmd 1 VM.flags.
